sn12.67:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn12.67:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn12.67:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito ā yasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn12.67:1.4: kiṃ nu kho āvuso sāriputtaṃ sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ parakataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ sayaṃkatañca parakatañca jarāmaraṇaṃ udāhu asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇanti.

sn12.67:7.3: upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
sn12.67:7.4: seyyathāpi āvuso dve naḷakalāpiyo aññamaññaṃ nissāya tiṭṭheyyuṃ
